[[File:MakutaiApprenticeRobe-TSL.jpg|thumb|]]
These '''robes''' were worn by individuals who had just begun their training in the [[Matukai/Legends|Matukai]] philosophy of achieving harmony between the mind and body. The Matukai were an order of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] who used exercise as a form of meditation. The balance of the physical body and spiritual [[The Force/Legends|Force]] was the cornerstone of their philosophy.
